_comment: Copy to main.parameters.json (which infra/.gitignore excludes) and fill in.
TWO OF THESE ARE SECRETS AND THIS FILE HOLDS NEITHER. `appSecret` and `databaseAdminPassword`
are shown here as empty strings on purpose: a placeholder that looks like a value is how a
development secret reaches production. Generate both, and prefer passing them on the command
line from a password manager over writing them into your copy of this file at all —

_comment_viewerOrigin: Empty is the shipped state: one Container App serving the viewer and the API from one
origin. Fill it in ONLY when the viewer is hosted separately (infra/azure/swa/), and then
with the static site's origin and no trailing slash. It moves ELEVATOR_SIM_ORIGIN and
ELEVATOR_SIM_ALLOW_ORIGIN together; the server refuses to boot if they disagree.
Order and the third value: docs/16-static-site-deployment.md § 3.
